messages:
Anika Rao: Quick sync on authz cache plan. Were seeing 60-120ms p50 in policy eval for some hot routes. Need to discuss per-tenant cache sharding, invalidation, and correctness guarantees. Thoughts? :thinking:

Tomás Rivera: Agree perf is high. Two levers: 1) cache evaluated decision blobs (allow/deny + meta) per (subject, resource, action) key, 2) cache compiled policy IR for repeated evals. The tradeoff is staleness when roles/permissions change.

Priya Singh: Staleness surface is real. For user-facing authz updates (admin revokes role) we need near-immediate effect. For service-to-service calls maybe eventual is ok. Suggest different TTL classes: admin-change TTL=0 with push invalidate, default TTL=30s, and long-lived TTL=5m for low-risk caches.

Dmitri Volkov: Push invalidation implies we need tenant-specific channels. We could publish invalidation messages to nats/topic:authz.invalidate.<org_id> and gateways subscribe. But what if the gateway missed message? Need TTL as fallback.

Anika Rao: That sounds reasonable. Also consider including a small version number in policy blobs so services can detect out-of-order invalidations. Invalidation message payload: {org, policy_v, keys: [...]}.

policy-bot: Draft RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026/authz-cache-sharding (automated). Please attach perf numbers and experiment plan.

Tomás Rivera: Concern: memory footprint on gateways if we shard per-tenant aggressively. For orgs with many projects we could do a two-level key: cache key = sha(org + project + subject + action) and shard by org hash -> N shards per-region. Limits per-shard per-node to avoid OOM.

Priya Singh: Another approach: Bypass gateway cache for sensitive routes and use a dedicated policy-cache sidecar for high-QPS services. Sidecar can keep bigger cache and do consistent invalidation via raft or redis streams. Gateway stays lightweight.

Dmitri Volkov: Sidecar adds operational complexity but isolates memory. We should prototype both: gateway local LRU cache with invalidation via NATS + TTL fallback, and sidecar that persists cache and handles invalidation ordering. Compare p50/p95 and error modes.

Anika Rao: For correctness tests we need end-to-end: 1) change role binding -> push invalidation -> subsequent request must see deny within 500ms in canary traffic. 2) Simulate missed invalidation by queuing drop -> TTL fallback should deny within TTL window. Add chaos tests for message broker downtime.

Tomás Rivera: Also add audit trail: every invalidation should be recorded with correlation id. We must avoid silent silently dropped invalidations. Metric: invalidation_ack_rate per-tenant, invalidation_lag histogram.

Priya Singh: API for invalidation in admin UI: POST /v1/admin/invalidate HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "org_id": "org_123",
  "policy_version": "v5",
  "keys": ["user:alice:project:billing:read"]
}
Return 202 with correlation id. UI shows progress.

Dmitri Volkov: For multi-region, ensure invalidation is global: publish to global topic and replicate; but tune for cross-region latency. Maybe use eventual push + local TTLs tuned by region.

Anika Rao: Ops/runbook items: 1) if invalidation lag > 1s spike, throttle admin writes and open an incident; 2) if cache hit rate drops unexpectedly, check shard imbalance; 3) on message broker outage, enable degraded path (longer TTL but admin-change flag forces gateway to query central policy store synchronously).

sre-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance for nats-cluster 2026-04-02T01:00 UTC. Expect brief message loss risk.

Tomás Rivera: Action items: - Prototype gateway LRU + NATS invalidation (owner: Tomás) - Prototype policy sidecar + durable pubsub (owner: Dmitri) - E2E tests & chaos (owner: Priya) - Add metrics & dashboards (owner: Anika) Ill open a tracking issue and link the RFC.

Priya Singh: I'll draft the e2e test plan with latency assertions and sample payloads.

Dmitri Volkov: I'll add memory/heap targets for sidecar and simulate high-tenant counts in load test.

Anika Rao: Thanks all. Will consolidate into RFC follow-up and include sample dashboards. Closing for now, please add PRs to the tracking issue. :white_check_mark:
